title: An escaped star is a plain star
head: f1760da5a0e350a7b6726669de6671c4084b875a

clause.text: An escaped `\*`, `\_` or `\~` is a plain character, and never opens or ends emphasis, strong or struck-out text, as on GitHub: `Use *\*.kt* files` is "Use *.kt files", "*.kt" in italics

scenes.caption: "Use *\*.kt* files": "*.kt" in italics, its star kept, no backslash, no stray star
"_a \_ b_": "a _ b" in italics, the escaped underscore kept inside
